statement_scope: Whole original Simon Problem5 on physical3 (printed284 continuing to285): for every irrational original alpha at coupling lambda=2, the spectrum of the almost-Mathieu operator has zero Lebesgue measure. Example2.2 on the same scanned spread writes potential lambda*cos(pi*alpha*n+theta); the proof paper writes lambda*cos(2*pi*(x+n*alpha)). Parameter names are retained: alpha_paper=alpha_original/2 and x_paper=theta_original/(2*pi), so irrationality and the full phase range agree. The coupling amplitude is2 in both these particular PDFs. Theorem1.5 states measure |4-2*lambda| for every irrational frequency; its explicit critical-case proof covers the remaining constant-type frequencies and invokes already-known non-constant-type cases without weakening 'every'. Phase independence is retained; this task is not the all-nonzero-coupling Cantor-spectrum Problem4 nor absolute continuity Problem6.
